method: Hash every canonical artifact path once. Compare the existing whole-file read with a synchronous 1 MiB fixed-buffer stream; preserve path safety, SHA-256, owner fan-out, outcome order, and failure classification.

comparison.interpretation: Streaming is a memory-safety optimization, not a wall-time optimization on this profile. It preserves every outcome while trading about five percent more time for an 83.7 percent lower process peak RSS.

limitations: The two variants ran sequentially against a live read-only artifact set; operating-system cache state was not forcibly reset.
The probe isolates unique-path artifact verification. It does not estimate the peak RSS of the complete check pipeline, whose index phase also retains a large lexical posting structure.
No live source, artifact, cache, or installed plugin file was written.
